whyItMatters: The response carries no Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy header.
actions: Decide whether the document needs cross-origin isolation.
If it does, send require-corp and make each embedded resource carry CORP or CORS; if it does not, record the decision and leave the header out.
verification: Request the document and confirm the policy is either absent by documented decision, or present with require-corp while every subresource still loads.
